snippet.title: Tangy TD Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
*Wishlist ➤* https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245620/Tangy_TD?utm_source=YouTube
Twitch ➤ https://www.twitch.tv/cakez77

Tangy TD is a strategic tower defense where enemies fight back! Play heroine Tangy, move towers, attack & unlock roguelite upgrades! Place class-based Towers (Defender, Archer, Healer) Equip them with items, some with abilities. Combine them to create powerful builds. Supported by an extensive Skilltree.

It started as an inspiration from Path of Exile's massive Skilltree which basically allows you to make ANY build you could think of. My biggest problem with traditional TD's is that you get locked into predefined upgrade paths which becomes quite boring really fast. So In order to create something with more options, I adopted the stat system from POE and added that onto items that can be equipped on your towers.

You can equip almost any item on every class of tower, allowing you to combine them as you see fit. It becomes more about finding strong item & ability combinations, which is something I really like about POE. Currently there are about 100 Items and roughly 20 Abilities in the game, allowing for quite a number of different builds.

····················································································

*About Me*
Hey! And welcome. I'm an indie game developer, currently working on a Tower Defense Game written entirely in C/C++, I tried using Unity or Unreal Engine in the past, but never really found much success. I'm mostly posting devlog / devblog videos where I show off the progress I make on the game.
